# Metropolis Healthcare

> India's leading pathology and diagnostic center network offering blood tests, health checkups, and specialized screening services with home sample collection across major cities.

Metropolis Healthcare is a comprehensive diagnostic and pathology services provider operating across India and Africa. The platform enables patients to book online blood tests, full-body health packages, organ-specific screening, and corporate wellness programs with convenient home visit options.
